product_request: Hi there, hope you're well! We met at the trade fair last spring and I've been meaning to get in touch. We're a small boutique in Galway and business has been great this year. We're thinking of expanding our range and would be interested in some knitwear, maybe 60 wool jumpers in mixed sizes, and possibly some scarves too if the price is right. Let me know what you think. Kind regards, Rachel
